arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The starting path for the cleanup. Defaults to current  directory.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Glob paths to exclude from cleanup.

options.name: --include
options.description: Glob paths to include in cleanup. Default paths: **/bin,  **/obj, **/node_modules.

options.name: --no-delete
options.description: Skip deleting matched paths after moving them to temporary folder. Ignored when --noop is used.

options.name: --no-move
options.description: Skip moving matched paths to temporary folder before  deletion. Ignored when --noop is used.

options.name: --noop
options.description: No-op mode: list matching paths without moving or deleting anything. Equivalent to --no-move and --no-delete.

options.name: --temp-path
options.description: Temporary path to move cleanup files before deletion.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Sets the verbosity level. Allowed values are minimal (m),  normal (n) and detailed (d).
